title: Sheaf Hom of sheaves of modules on a site
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$, and
$\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules. For an object $U$ of
$\mathcal C$ write $\mathcal F|_U$ for the restriction of $\mathcal F$ to the
localized site $\mathcal C/U$. The *sheaf Hom*
$\mathcal{H}om_{\mathcal O}(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)$ is the presheaf

$$
 U\longmapsto\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O|_U}
 (\mathcal F|_U,\mathcal G|_U),
$$

the set of $\mathcal O|_U$-linear maps of sheaves on $\mathcal C/U$, with the
restriction map along $V\to U$ given by restricting a map on $\mathcal C/U$ to
$\mathcal C/V$, and with $f\in\mathcal O(U)$ acting on $\varphi$ by composing
$\varphi$ with multiplication by $f$. This presheaf is a sheaf of
$\mathcal O$-modules, and its global sections are
$\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O}(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)$ (the statement
that it is a sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules is a theorem of its own, from which
this definition takes its sheaf structure). In the twist
notation of the blueprint, $\operatorname{Hom}_{\Lambda_S}(\Lambda(-m),\Lambda_S)$
for a sheaf $\Lambda(-m)$ of $\Lambda_S$-modules on a site denotes this sheaf
Hom.

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against Stacks 04TT/03EM (sites-modules.tex, section-internal-hom). Corrected 'sheaf of rings' to 'sheaf of commutative rings': the O(U)-module structure (pre- and post-composition with multiplication by f agree) needs commutativity, which Stacks assumes by convention. Named the notions it is built from: sheaves of O-modules (def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, Mathlib leaf), the localized ringed site C/U with restriction of modules and relocalization (new def-pur-localized-ringed-site, Mathlib leaf `SheafOfModules.over`/`overMap` on `J.over U`), Hom of sheaves of modules as a module over global sections (new def-pur-sheaf-modules-hom-module, unsplit: Mathlib has only AddCommGroup on Hom), and the theorem that the rule U ↦ Hom(F|_U,G|_U) is a sheaf of O-modules with global sections Hom_O(F,G) (new lem-pur-sheaf-hom-is-sheaf, unsplit: Mathlib's presheafHom/sheafHom are Type-valued for sheaves in a fixed category), from which the definition takes its sheaf structure instead of asserting it. Searched Mathlib again for a module-valued internal Hom (Sheaf.internalHom, presheafHom, SheafOfModules, PresheafOfModules, ModuleCat.monoidalClosed): none, so the item is not a one-line specialization.
